constraints.definition: CHECK (direction = 'Income'::text AND (category = ANY (ARRAY['PrizeMoney'::text, 'AppearanceFee'::text, 'Support'::text, 'Sponsorship'::text, 'RevenueShare'::text, 'Buyout'::text, 'Campaign'::text, 'TravelReimbursement'::text, 'Other'::text])) OR direction = 'Expense'::text AND (category = ANY (ARRAY['RegistrationFee'::text, 'Travel'::text, 'Accommodation'::text, 'PlayerFee'::text, 'Equipment'::text, 'Logistics'::text, 'Contingency'::text, 'Other'::text])))

constraints.name: mission_line_payment_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (direction = 'Income'::text AND payment_status IS NOT NULL AND (payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['Expected'::text, 'Invoiced'::text, 'Received'::text])) OR direction = 'Expense'::text AND payment_status IS NULL AND received_amount_minor IS NULL AND received_usd_per_unit IS NULL AND payment_source_label IS NULL AND ref_no IS NULL)

constraints.name: mission_line_received_only
constraints.definition: CHECK (payment_status = 'Received'::text OR received_amount_minor IS NULL AND received_usd_per_unit IS NULL)

constraints.name: mission_line_usd_snapshot_unity
